description: This class defines an immutable representation of a JSON number specifically for integers within the project. It provides methods for creation, equality comparison, serialization, and size estimation, extending a base class for JSON numbers.

classes.name: ImmutableJsonInt
classes.description: An immutable class representing a JSON integer number, fitting within Java's int range. Provides methods for object creation, equality, hashing, serialization, and size estimation.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Static factory method to create an instance of ImmutableJsonInt with the specified integer value.

methods.name: isInt
methods.description: Indicates that this numeric representation is an integer.

methods.name: isLong
methods.description: Indicates that this numeric representation can also be considered a long.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks equality with another object, optimized for comparing with other AbstractJsonNumber instances.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Returns a hash code based on the integer value.

methods.name: writeValue
methods.description: Serializes this number to the provided SerializationContext.

methods.name: getUpperBoundForStringSize
methods.description: Estimates the maximum string size needed to represent this number.
